relationships.subject: Formoterol
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that Formoterol treatment attenuated the CSF-1-induced expression of inflammatory mediators such as interleukin 1 alpha (IL-1α), interferon-gamma (INF-γ), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-α), and interleukin 17 (IL-17)

relationships.subject: Formoterol
relationships.evidence_quote: In both male and female mice, Formoterol injection significantly reduced SNI-induced mechanical hypersensitivity, compared to saline-treated SNI mice

relationships.subject: Formoterol
relationships.evidence_quote: Immunoreactivity for phosphorylated p38 in Iba1-expressing microglia was significantly enhanced in male and female mice at early (3 days post-SNI) and late (21 days post-SNI) time points after SNI and was completely reversed by Formoterol treatment at all time points

relationships.subject: spinal cord microglia
relationships.evidence_quote: Thus, we conclude that the expression of Adrb2 is specifically upregulated in spinal cord microglia early after nerve injury.

key_findings: Formoterol via microglial β2-AR alleviates SNI-induced mechanical and cold hypersensitivity; the effect is lost in microglia-specific Adrb2 knockout mice.
Formoterol reduces microglial activation and pro-inflammatory signaling, and reduces astrogliosis at late stages independently of microglial β2-AR.
